sloka: न ह्यादानं न सन्धानं धनुषो वा परिग्रहः।न विप्रमोक्षो बाणानां न विकर्षो न विग्रहः ।। ६.९०.२९ ।।
transliteration: na hyādānaṁ na sandhānaṁ dhanuṣo vā parigrahaḥ।na vipramokṣo bāṇānāṁ na vikarṣo na vigrahaḥ ।। 6.90.29 ।।

translations.english: Both the mighty and energetic heroes, covered each other with arrows just as after summer the moon and Sun are veiled frequently by clouds.
